incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: unusual auth traffic from sidecar-proxy (svc: sidecar-ingress-usw2). 4000 req/min anomalous spike vs baseline 120 req/min. Investigate.
Dmitri: I'm on it, grabbing logs from the edge cluster.
Carla: tagging sec oncall @Alice, this smells like token replay + leaked headers.
Alice: looking now — can someone drop the ingress sidecar logs and a sample header?
Dmitri: pasted sample in the logstore: https://logs.internal/r/sidecar-ingress-usw2/stream/1777777777 (redacted)
Bob: seeing repeated Authorization: Bearer <token-fragment> across many IPs, some from cloudscraper ranges.
Emma: confirmed — tokens are short-lived but reused. Could be credential sampling or a proxy leak.
Alice: run quick validation: which customers hit errors? run `SELECT count(*) FROM auth_events WHERE token_reuse=true AND region='us-west-2';`
Dmitri: quick count: ~2.3k unique sessions flagged in the last 10m. A few correlate with customer-tenant ids: cust-248, cust-512.
Carla: potential customer impact — contact CS lead for affected tenants. I'll draft a notification after we confirm containment.
Morgan: recommended immediate mitigation: 1) throttle the offending IP ranges via WAF 2) block sidecar egress to telemetry endpoint 3) force short rotation for tokens issued in last 30m. Thoughts?
Bob: WAF rule applied for the top 20 offending IPs: `waf rule block ipset:sidecar-suspect-1777` — applied 1777777785.
Dmitri: I pushed a config change to disable sidecar header propagation to downstream logs: `env SIDEcar_PROPAGATE_HEADERS=false` on canary nodes. Rolling to 20% now.
Alice: good. Also switch auth validation to reject reused tokens server-side: `auth.reject_on_replay = true` — enabling on canary auth-proxy.
Carla: start key rotation plan for affected service account keys. We'll rotate the requester service tokens and issue new short-lived tokens.
Emma: quick script to revoke sessions for tenants cust-248 and cust-512: ```
POST /admin/sessions/revoke
{ "tenant_id": "cust-248,cust-512", "reason": "suspected token replay" }
```
Dmitri: revoke script queued and executed at 1777777802 — telemetry shows session churn as expected.
Bob: sidecar metrics: request rate dropped 85% after WAF block and header propagation disable.
Carla: confirm logs archived to secure bucket and redact before any external sharing. Note: rotate KMS key for archived logs after export.
Alice: security oncall handoff to Carla in 15m for followups, I'll stay for postmortem. @Carla take it from here.
Carla: taking lead. Next steps: 1) customer outreach draft, 2) rotate service account creds, 3) do forensics on token origin, 4) update runbook with new sidecar hardening.
Emma: customer outreach draft: "We detected anomalous reuse of tokens affecting your tenant. We have revoked sessions and are rotating credentials. No sign of data exfiltration so far. We will keep you updated."
Morgan: I'll schedule a canary rollout of the stricter header-sanitization across all regions once we validate metrics stable for 30m.
Dmitri: follow-up check at 1777777845: no new token replay events, WAF holding.
Bob: logs snapshot saved `s3://secure-archives/incident-1777777777/log-snapshot.tar.gz` (access: sec-team only).
Carla: legal and compliance looped in. Filing initial incident report and severity: P2 until we confirm root cause.
Alice: good job. After-action items: revamp sidecar header filtering, add token-reuse alerts to runbook, and tighten telemetry egress ACLs.
incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, severity=P2, assignee=Carla, incident_id=INC-1777-ALPHA
Carla: I'll post a short timeline and next steps in #postmortems once incident is closed. :thumbsup:
Dmitri: leaving notes in the runbook: `sidecar-harden.md` with steps we ran.
Alice: I'll join postmortem. Marking this thread resolved for now.
